cases.question: How does an order refund work?

items.text: Refunds return a paid order's money to the original payment method. The service checks that the order was paid, requests a refund from the payment provider, and records the refunded status after confirmation.

export async function refundOrder(orderId: string) { const order = await orders.get(orderId); if (order.status !== 'paid') throw new Error('Order must be paid'); const refund = await payments.refund(order.paymentId); await orders.update(orderId, { status: 'refunded', refundId: refund.id }); return refund; }

cases.question: How are expired cache entries removed?

items.text: pub fn remove_expired(&mut self, now: Instant) { self.entries.retain(|_, entry| entry.expires_at > now); }

Cache expiration prevents stale values from being reused. A cleanup pass compares each entry's expiration time with the current time. Entries that have already expired are removed; entries whose expiration is still in the future are retained.
